g.text: Transport kinds: base creates, overlay wraps
Proxy kinds: carrier below, payload above
Core-facing: what core and modules meet on
an IP and a port, already resolved:
exactly one of a domain or an IP,
plus a port; a domain stays a domain
until the base transport resolves it
Info() ModuleInfo{Name, Description}: constant, never from a setting
The module value is its own configuration: settings decode straight into it.
Callers test them with errors.Is; modules never invent parallel ones.
